text:
The response fails to meet the core constraints of the prompt. It exceeds the 10-line limit significantly (containing roughly 20 lines). More critically, the mathematical content is incorrect and incoherent; it does not constitute a valid proof of the irrationality of √2 (e.g., claiming a line divided into equal sections has one side longer than the other). The rhymes are forced and often do not actually rhyme (e.g., "number/demonstration," "right/bend," "for/number"). It lacks the rigor expected of a mathematician and the concision expected of a poet.

Rating: [[2]]
